events.title: 울버햄프턴 원더러스 sack manager Mark McGhee after three years at the helm.

Peter Schmeichel , goalkeeper of 맨체스터 유나이티드 since 1991, announces his intention to leave the club at the end of this season. Roy Evans resigns as joint manager of 리버풀 after nearly five years in charge and more than 30 years on the club's payroll, leaving Gérard Houllier in sole charge.

콜체스터 유나이티드 fall victim to arguably the biggest upset of the FA Cup fourth round when they are defeated 4–1 by non-league Bedlington Terriers . Other Football League clubs to be eliminated by non-league counterparts include 바닛 , 사우스엔드 유나이티드 and 슈루즈버리 타운 .

블랙번 로버스 lose 2–0 at home to 사우샘프턴, leaving them bottom of the Premier League with a mere nine points from their opening 14 games. Manager 로이 호지슨 resigns within hours of the defeat. Long-serving coach Tony Parkes is put in charge of the first team on a temporary basis. On the same day, 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer a shock 3–1 defeat at 셰필드 웬즈데이.

November draws to a close with 애스턴 빌라 still leading 맨체스터 유나이티드 by a single point, but a surprise title challenge is creeping upon them from a 웨스트햄 유나이티드 side with no previous top division titles to their name, and who have not finished in the top five for more than a decade. 아스널 and 첼시 complete the top five. 블랙번 로버스 now prop up the top flight, having started the season among the teams tipped by many to challenge for the title. 사우샘프턴 and 노팅엄 포리스트 remain in the drop zone. 선덜랜드 continue to lead Division One, their nearest threat coming from 입스위치 타운. 왓퍼드, 버밍엄 시티, 볼턴 원더러스 and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the top six, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 providing the closest competition for the top six after a rejuvenation under new manager Colin Lee .
